invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.22.0 preserves the completed billing product, business-owner payment provider connections, and customer-facing Pay Now for public and portal invoices. Hosted checkout is supported through connected Pesapal, Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave and PayPal accounts while direct M-PESA remains verified C2B reconciliation. Customer checkout never accepts browser-supplied financial authority: invoice identity, balance and currency are derived server-side; merchant credentials remain encrypted; provider returns and signed webhooks converge on duplicate-safe settlement through the authoritative payment, allocation, invoice-status and Accounting-posting core. The release gate includes Invoicing regressions, customer checkout contracts, payment-provider connector contracts, parity-hardening, quality locks, module migrations, responsive/app UI, ERP integration, TypeScript and production build.
